Almost all Democrats disapprove of Trump's job performance: 4% approve and 95% disapprove, for a net approval of -91. This near-unanimous disapproval from Democrats has been the case for most of Trump's second term.

Trump's job approval among Independents has been falling. Currently 18% of Independents approve of Trump's job performance and 71% disapprove, a net job approval of -53. That's down from 32% approval and 60% disapproval (-28 net) among Independents at the start of the year. [...] Register
